tree.name: System Architecture
tree.description: **Loqui Studio** is a full-stack character authoring platform and interactive conversational engine built around a split **FastAPI ASGI backend** and **Vue 3 SPA frontend**. The system divides its logic across four primary domains: a **Backend Core & API** layer (handling Socket.IO real-time streaming, finite-state dialogue orchestration, hybrid FAISS/BM25 RAG, and local/cloud LLM & speech services), a **Frontend SPA** (providing Vue Flow node-graph authoring, live sandbox debugging, and text/voice chat interfaces), a **Verification & Testing Suite** (validating schemas, intent dispatching, topology rules, and end-to-end flows), and **Infrastructure & Documentation** (automating dual-stack bootstrapping and capturing architectural constraints).

children.name: Backend Core & API
children.description: Houses the **Python FastAPI and Socket.IO server**, orchestrating finite-state dialogue traversal, hybrid retrieval-augmented generation, SQLite conversation persistence, and multimodal STT/TTS pipelines.

children.name: Application Entry & API Layer
children.description: Exposes **HTTP REST endpoints and real-time Socket.IO channels**, backed by SQLite persistence and structured terminal logging.

children.name: Server Entry & Configuration
children.description: Bootstraps the **ASGI runtime, CORS policies, and Socket.IO event handlers** while loading system-wide LLM, Ollama, and Jev presets.

files.description: Acts as the **primary ASGI entry point**, binding a `socketio.AsyncServer` together with the FastAPI application and registering character and conversation routers. It orchestrates real-time `chat_message` and `audio_message` Socket.IO events through `process_dialogue_turn`, lazily loads Whisper STT and OmniVoice TTS models, and mounts compiled frontend static assets when available.

Centralizes **runtime configuration defaults**, including server host/port bindings, `idle_timeout_seconds`, and `llm_presets` parameters. It also defines connection settings and model identifiers for both local **Ollama** inference/embeddings and the external **Jev** intent-classification API.

children.name: REST API Endpoints
children.description: Provides **RESTful resource handlers** for character asset CRUD, ephemeral draft sandbox execution, and persistent chat history management.

files.description: Implements the **`/api/characters` router**, managing atomic file reads/writes for `info.json`, `prompts.yaml` (via a block-style `ruamel.yaml` round-trip parser), `layout.json`, and avatar uploads. It also exposes `/rag-schemes` metadata discovery and the `/test-draft` endpoint that runs the **unified dialogue pipeline** against transient unsaved editor payloads.

Defines the **`/api/conversations` FastAPI router** with Pydantic request schemas for creating, listing, updating, and deleting persistent chat sessions. It delegates database operations to `conversation_repo` to track `current_node_id` and append `user` or `character` messages.

children.name: Persistence & Logging
children.description: Manages **SQLite relational storage** for conversation threads and provides **color-coded console telemetry** across pipeline stages.

files.description: Marks `backend/scripts/db` as a **Python package**, enabling modular imports of the SQLite connection manager and repository functions across the API layer.

Configures the **SQLite database connection and schema initialization** (`loqui_studio.db`), enforcing foreign keys and row-factory dictionary mapping. Its `_SCHEMA` defines the `conversations` and `messages` tables with cascading deletes and role constraints.

Implements the **data access repository** encapsulating all SQL queries for conversation lifecycle management and message insertion. Notably, `list_conversations` uses a `MAX(rowid)` subquery to efficiently fetch each thread's latest message preview ordered by `updated_at`.

Provides the **`PipelineLogger` utility** powered by `rich.console.Console` with a custom color theme. It standardizes structured diagnostic output across RAG retrieval, LLM streaming status, STT transcription, and FSM flow transitions.

children.name: Dialogue Orchestration & State
children.description: Controls **conversational state transitions, intent routing, and graph topology integrity** independently of frontend presentation libraries.

children.name: Pipeline & FSM Traversal
children.description: Executes the **unified dialogue loop**, combining dynamic reactive intent evaluation with deterministic FSM node stepping and prompt assembly.

files.description: Contains **`run_dialogue_pipeline`**, the unified execution engine shared by live Socket.IO sessions and ephemeral `/test-draft` runs. It coordinates Ollama model preloading, reactive intent dispatching, open-topic shelving/resumption, bridge directives, Hybrid RAG fetching/reuse, and final system/user prompt construction.

Implements **FSM graph traversal** via `traverse_fsm`, `get_automatic_transition`, and `evaluate_prompt_transition`. It automatically advances through control nodes (`start-node`, `loop-node`, `cycle-node`, `end-node`) while invoking LLM classification when a prompt node branches across multiple conditional targets.

Manages **dynamic reactive topic switching** by converting `reactive` nodes and shelved `open_topics` into tool schemas (`build_intent_tools`) and Jev choice schemas (`build_jev_choice_schema`). In `evaluate_intent`, it queries the Jev decision API when configured or falls back to keyword scoring via `_fallback_intent_match`.

children.name: Session & Schema Management
children.description: Tracks **transient runtime state**, defines Pydantic validation contracts for draft payloads, and enforces **structural graph rules**.

files.description: Defines **`ChatSession`, `Session`, and `SessionManager`** to maintain per-connection in-memory conversation state. Beyond history and `current_node_id`, `ChatSession` tracks `loop_counters`, `active_flow_id`, `open_topics` stacks, and `last_retrieved_chunks` for RAG reuse.

Declares **Pydantic data models** (`SessionState`, `DraftConfig`, and `EphemeralPayload`) that formalize the structure of transient testing payloads. These models capture in-memory `info`, `prompts`, `layout`, and active session pointers passed between editor and backend.

Provides **`validate_character_graph`**, a breadth-first graph crawler that inspects `var_prompt` node topologies. It enforces the architectural invariant that every `reactive` node in `flow` mode has a reachable path terminating at a `bridge-node`.

children.name: AI & Retrieval Services
children.description: Abstracts **local and cloud AI providers** for text generation, dense/sparse hybrid retrieval, and voice synthesis/recognition.

children.name: LLM & Hybrid RAG Engines
children.description: Delivers **provider-agnostic LLM streaming**, local Ollama VRAM lifecycle management, and **FAISS + BM25 Hybrid RAG** with POV and metadata filtering.

files.description: Implements **`api_request` and token counting** (`tiktoken`), dynamically routing chat completions to local Ollama (`/api/chat`), OpenAI cloud models, or an offline simulation fallback. It maps preset hyperparameters across providers and yields uniform streaming generators.

Manages **local Ollama daemon health and model residency** via HTTP calls to `/api/ps` and `/api/generate`. Its `manage_models` routine unloads unused models and preloads configured `llm_model` and `embedding_model` instances with persistent `keep_alive`.

Implements the **Hybrid RAG subsystem** (`RAGIndex` and `retrieve_hybrid`), combining `BM25Okapi` lexical scoring (with English/Dutch spaCy stop-word removal) and `FAISS` dense vector search fused via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). It also supports query rewriting, **POV filtering**, metadata pre-filtering, E5 `query:`/`passage:` prefixes, and automatic index reloading.

children.name: Speech Processing (STT & TTS)
children.description: Provides **lazy-loaded, thread-safe local audio pipelines** for converting visitor speech to text and synthesizing character voice replies.

files.description: Handles **local Whisper STT** by asynchronously lazy-loading `openai/whisper-tiny` in a daemon thread to avoid blocking server startup. It decodes incoming WebM audio bytes into 16kHz float32 PCM via `ffmpeg` pipes and runs language-aware transcription.

Integrates the **OmniVoice zero-shot TTS engine** (`k2-fsa/OmniVoice`), preloading the model asynchronously and synchronizing inference with locks. It resolves per-character reference audio and transcripts (`resolve_character_ref_audio`) and outputs 24kHz WAV byte buffers.

children.name: Character Assets
children.description: Stores **file-based character definitions** using decoupled metadata, YAML prompt graphs, and visual canvas coordinates.

children.name: Henk de Bredanaar Persona
children.description: Concrete character blueprint for **Henk, a Breda B&B host**, demonstrating Dutch dialect instructions, RAG metadata filters, loops, and reactive sub-flows.

files.description: Defines **core character metadata** for `henk_de_bredanaar`, setting Dutch language (`nl`), UI accent color, idle timeout bounds, and RAG binding to the `Breda` scheme without POV restrictions.

Contains Henk's **complete behavioral and dialogue graph** (`base_prompt`, `do`/`don't` guardrails, `context`, and `var_prompt` nodes). It exercises `start-node`, `loop-node`, bridged `reactive` flows (`Eten` and `Reactive Flow` with `rag_filters`), and `standalone` reactive deflections.
Persists the **2D visual coordinates and edge connections** for Henk's node graph in the editor canvas, keeping frontend layout geometry decoupled from backend `prompts.yaml` execution logic.

children.name: Frontend SPA
children.description: Implements the **Vue 3 and Vite single-page application**, providing character discovery, persistent text/voice chat, and a node-based visual character studio with live sandbox debugging.

children.name: Application Bootstrap & Shell
children.description: Configures **Vite dev proxying, module aliases, Pinia state, Vue Router navigation**, and shared HTTP history helpers.

children.name: Build & Entry Setup
children.description: Establishes the **HTML shell, Vite API/WebSocket proxy, global CSS design tokens**, and root Vue instance mounting.

files.description: Serves as the **SPA HTML entry template**, mounting the `#app` container and loading `/src/main.js` as an ES module.
Configures **Vite build plugins (`vue`, `vueDevTools`) and dev-server proxying**, forwarding `/api` HTTP requests and `/socket.io` WebSocket upgrades to the FastAPI backend at `127.0.0.1:5000`.
Configures **JavaScript IDE path resolution**, mapping the `@/*` alias to `./src/*` for consistent editor intellisense.
Bootstraps the **Vue 3 application instance**, registering Pinia state management and Vue Router before mounting `App.vue`.

Renders the **top-level application shell**, pairing the persistent `AppNavbar` with `<router-view />` and defining global CSS custom properties (`--primary`, `--border`, `--nav-height`) and viewport flex layout.

children.name: Routing, State & Utilities
children.description: Coordinates **client-side routes, shared navbar actions, and REST API wrappers** for conversation persistence.

files.description: Defines the **Vue Router history configuration**, mapping `/`, `/characters`, `/characters/new`, `/characters/:id/edit`, and `/chat/:id?` to their corresponding page views.
Implements the **`useNavbarStore` Pinia store**, allowing views like `CharacterEditorView` to dynamically inject contextual action buttons (such as **Save**) into the global `AppNavbar`.

Provides **async fetch wrappers** around `/api/conversations` (`getSessions`, `createSession`, `getSession`, `deleteSession`, `appendMessage`, and `updateNode`) to synchronize chat UI state with SQLite persistence.

children.name: Page Views
children.description: Delivers the **primary user workflows** across recent activity dashboards, character catalogs, live multimodal chat, and persona authoring.

children.name: Discovery & Live Chat Views
children.description: Powers **character selection, conversation history browsing, and real-time text/voice Socket.IO sessions**.

files.description: Displays the **landing dashboard** featuring recently available character cards and a two-column grid of past conversation sessions, enabling one-click resumption or new chat creation.
Renders the **character gallery grid** fetched from `/api/characters`, combining a dashed `+` creation card with `CharacterCard` tiles that route either to live chat or the visual editor.

Implements the **full-featured live chat interface** with a session-history sidebar, Socket.IO streaming text bubbles, hold-to-record WebM `MediaRecorder` voice capture, and sequential `Audio` playback of synthesized TTS WAV responses.

children.name: Character Authoring Views
children.description: Supports **bootstrapping new character templates** and editing personas via synchronized forms, node graphs, and live testing.

files.description: Provides the **character creation wizard**, slugifying the template name and persisting a starter `info.json`, `prompts.yaml`, and `layout.json` (`Start` -> `Welcome`) before redirecting to the editor.

Serves as the **unified character studio** (`Base prompt` and `Graph` tabs), managing in-memory drafts, avatar uploads, node property inspectors, automatic `bridge-node` spawning for reactive flows, topology validation, and live `TestChatPanel` previews.

children.name: Reusable UI Components
children.description: Encapsulates **modular presentation and authoring widgets**, including the Vue Flow canvas, metadata chip selectors, and sandbox debuggers.

children.name: Navigation & Cards
children.description: Supplies **consistent top-bar navigation** and interactive **character preview cards**.

files.description: Renders the **global top navigation bar** with active route highlighting (`Characters`, `Chat`) and a reactive action button bound to `useNavbarStore`.
Displays a **3:4 aspect-ratio character card** with avatar fallback, hover gradient overlays, description reveal, and an optional quick-edit trigger button.

children.name: Graph & Sandbox Components
children.description: Implements the **Vue Flow visual editor**, RAG metadata filter UI, client-side validation gate, and **telemetry-rich test chat panel**.

files.description: Wraps **`@vue-flow/core`** to render custom node templates (`start`, `end`, `loop` with Body/Exit handles, `cycle`, `bridge`, `reactive`, `prompt`, `deflect`, `silence`), right-click context menus, edge reconnection, and active-node pulse highlighting.

Provides an **interactive RAG metadata filter editor** populated from scheme catalogs, allowing authors to toggle chip values or enter comma-separated filter criteria on start, reactive flow, and fetch nodes.
Acts as a **visual testing gatekeeper** inside the editor's sandbox column, listing unmet persona or graph topology validation errors until the draft is ready for `/test-draft` execution.

Delivers the **in-editor sandbox chat and debug inspector**, invoking `/api/characters/test-draft`, copying formatted node-tagged logs, and rendering expandable drawers for `active_flow_id`, `intent`, `open_topics`, `dynamic_tools`, retrieved RAG chunks, and exact LLM prompts.

children.name: Verification & Testing Suite
children.description: Provides **automated phase checkpoints and standalone CLI test harnesses** to verify schemas, Jev intent dispatching, graph topology validation, Hybrid RAG, TTS, and multi-turn orchestration.

children.name: Phased Reactive Flow Tests
children.description: Implements the **four structured checkpoint scripts** verifying the reactive sub-flow and bridge-node architecture.

files.description: Verifies **Phase 1 data models**, asserting `ChatSession` flow/topic fields (`active_flow_id`, `open_topics`) and YAML serialization round-trips for `reactive` and `bridge-node` definitions.
Tests **Phase 2 intent routing**, validating dynamic tool schema generation, `evaluate_intent` classification against multi-turn history, and `assemble_bridge_directive` output for shelved topics.
Validates **Phase 4 graph crawling** in `validate_character_graph`, confirming that unbridged reactive flows are rejected while properly bridged graphs pass cleanly.
Executes a **Phase 5 end-to-end multi-turn simulation** (`Host Bram`), asserting flow pivoting, topic shelving into `open_topics`, bridge-node prompting, and resumption of the paused dining flow.

children.name: Standalone Subsystem Harnesses
children.description: Offers **targeted developer scripts** for exercising orchestration, HTTP draft testing, RAG queries, Jev decisions, and OmniVoice synthesis in isolation.

files.description: Runs an **async orchestration smoke test** loading the `example` character and a `hussite_wars` RAG scenario to verify FSM traversal, chunk retrieval, and streaming LLM responses.
Exercises the **live `/api/characters/test-draft` HTTP endpoint**, verifying both 200 OK grounded pipeline execution and 422 validation rejection on incomplete payloads.
Provides a **CLI tester for `retrieve_hybrid`**, accepting query, scheme, POV filter, and `top_k` arguments to inspect retrieved chunks and extracted metadata categories.
Tests **Jev API intent decision-making**, validating choice-schema construction (`--schema-only`), live scenario accuracy, and single-character queries against `JEV_API_KEY`.
Serves as a **minimal OmniVoice TTS benchmark script**, loading `k2-fsa/OmniVoice` on CUDA and synthesizing a Dutch sample prompt into `out.wav`.

children.name: Infrastructure & Documentation
children.description: Consolidates **cross-stack environment setup scripts, package manifests, and design documentation** detailing architecture decisions and implementation plans.

children.name: Environment & Dependency Tooling
children.description: Automates **Python virtual environments, GPU-aware PyTorch installation, Node dependencies**, and concurrent dev-server execution.

files.description: Acts as the **unified Windows launcher and setup script**, creating a Python 3.12 `.venv` via `uv`, auto-detecting NVIDIA GPUs (`nvidia-smi`) to install CUDA or CPU PyTorch, installing Python/Node dependencies, and dispatching `backend`, `frontend`, `b`, or `cmd` modes.
Defines **Node.js dependencies** (Vue 3, Pinia, Vue Router, `@vue-flow/*`, `socket.io-client`, Vite) and top-level npm scripts (`backend`, `frontend`, `start` via `concurrently`, and `build`).
Specifies **backend Python dependencies**, spanning FastAPI, Uvicorn, `python-socketio`, `ruamel.yaml`, `faiss-cpu`, `rank-bm25`, `openai`, `transformers`, `spacy`, and `omnivoice`.

children.name: Architecture & Developer Docs
children.description: Captures **product vision, technical topology, code quirks, and phased implementation checklists** for developers and AI assistants.

files.description: Provides **project onboarding documentation** for Loqui Studio, outlining prerequisites (`uv`, Python 3.10+, Node 18+, optional CUDA), `go.bat` usage commands, and the `backend/` vs `frontend/` directory layout.

Articulates the **product vision, user flows, and functional constraints**, contrasting instruction-driven persona autonomy against encyclopedia bots and detailing Museum/Experience vs Dev/Creator modes.
Documents the **system topology, communication protocols, and data schemas** (`info.json`, `prompts.yaml`, `layout.json`, RAG metadata), including end-to-end sequence traces for the unified pipeline.
Records **non-obvious code quirks and workarounds** for language model assistants, such as `torch.compile` avoidance on Windows, `LiteralDumper` YAML block formatting, and hot-mic capture strategies.
Tracks the **completed 5-phase implementation plan** for reactive flows, dynamic tool-calling intent dispatch, bridge nodes, graph topology validation, and debug telemetry checkpoints.
